title: 💬 What makes a good citizen?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What responsibilities should come with citizenship besides obeying the law?
Can someone be a good citizen while strongly criticising their government?
Should voting be considered a duty or simply a right?
How much should citizens be expected to help strangers in their community?
What behaviour would make you say, 'That person is contributing positively to society'?
